Synopsis:
    A UN Environment Programme report warns global heating will reach at least 1.8C even under the most optimistic scenario, making the 1.5C Paris Agreement target unavoidable to overshoot. The report stresses that every fraction of warming intensifies extreme weather, glacier melt, sea level rise and food insecurity. It calls for an "overshoot, peak and decline" pathway combining immediate emissions cuts with carbon removal, warning that existing national policies currently track toward 2.3C+. Net zero by mid-century remains the essential milestone.
